name: The bar below the bluff
note: A throwaway Region, made to prove that one costs a data file and not code (ADR-0014). It stands on the same heightmap as Council Bluff because a second survey is a separate job, but it names its own places, holds no council, keeps no camp and moors no fleet, and puts the smokes of a different people on the other side of the river.

points.name: start
points.note: A landing further down the reach.

landmark.name: The lookout
landmark.journal: A rise above the bottomland, from which the whole reach can be seen.
